description: This file defines a Spring service class 'CreateProvisioningJournalEntriesRequestCommandHandler' that handles commands to create provisioning journal entries in the Fineract accounting provisioning module. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, processes commands via a service, and is annotated with Spring stereotypes and custom command annotations.

classes.name: CreateProvisioningJournalEntriesRequestCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles creation commands for provisioning journal entries, integrating with the provisioning service to perform the creation operation.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to create provisioning journal entries by delegating to the provisioning service.
